rules.anchor_quote: This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties, except one- and two-family dwellings and non-landlord licensees.
rules.effective_expression: first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment

exemptions.description: Dwelling unit in a one-family or two-family dwelling offered for rent
exemptions.quote: (1) a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent; or

exemptions.description: Licensee of the NJ Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord
exemptions.quote: (2)  a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property.

key_values.name: penalty_first
key_values.text: up to $500 for a first offense

key_values.name: penalty_second
key_values.text: up to $750 for a second offense

key_values.name: penalty_subsequent
key_values.text: up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense

rules.penalty: Up to $500 first offense, up to $750 second offense, up to $1,000 each subsequent offense; wrongfully charged amount remitted to applicant.
rules.quote: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
rules.requirement: Landlords or their agents may not require an application or similar fee above $50 (CPI-adjusted annually). Violations carry civil penalties and the excess fee is remitted to the applicant.
rules.title: Application fee capped at $50
